title: What People Are Saying
subtitle: Featured in leading tech publications worldwide.

quotes.quote: I imported my Google Timeline to this self-hosted app, and it's so much better than what Google offers.
Dawarich gives you everything Google Timeline does, and then some. There are no ads and no hidden data collection.
The UI is clean and user friendly. Basically no impact on battery.

I travel globally 60-70% of the year and was looking for something to keep my record without handing it to Google. I found Dawarich.app, set up my iPhone app in a few minutes, imported my Timeline history, and it just runs — tracking starts itself when I leave the house. I don't think about it anymore. My data is now my data again and meanwhile I have 260k km, 16 countries and 378 cities tracked.
quotes.source: Germany · Global traveler · ex-Google Timeline · found via Reddit

quotes.quote: I used Google Timeline for years but never felt comfortable with my entire life sitting on U.S. servers. I moved everything (a few years' worth of data) into Dawarich in just an afternoon. Now I have a private, permanent diary of my life — something I hope to pass on to my grandchildren one day. I look forward to future enhancements as they have already done a remarkable job.
quotes.source: New York, U.S. · Former Google Timeline user · Building a location legacy

quotes.quote: I moved to Kazakhstan not knowing the city at all. Google Timeline wasn't an option anymore, and I didn't trust it either way. Set up Dawarich, and now the map is like fog of war for me — the more I go out, the more it fills in. Plus every trip stays with me — I can look back at any of them and share the route.
It's way better than OwnTracks, Overland, etc. — it's so much more accurate.
The app has been working great for me so far and hasn't had any effect on battery! Amazing job thus far!
I think it's a rather impressive piece of software.
